_about: TODO-19 stage 1 readout comparison (ReadoutStudy). Geometries: the repository baseline (1 mm pitch, no gap, virtual matched 1 mm sensors); 2 mm pixels with a 0.2 mm reflector (published GAGG array example); 3 mm pixels at the 3.2 mm pitch of commercial 3 mm SiPM arrays, with the default specular reflector, a diffuse reflector and a wider 0.5 mm wall. Sensors are matched 1:1 (a virtual sensor of the crystal's active width: an assumption). Readouts: four-output Anger with the ideal separable divider, the discretised positioning circuit at column/row resistance ratios 1.0 (equal resistors, the known failing case), 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.03 and 0.01 (RD-12: the engine-exported weights put the middle-row spot spacing at 0.15 / 0.43 / 0.54 / 0.69 / 0.84 / 0.89 of the ideal 2/S, the marker-suppression boundary at 0.5 lying between 0.3 and 0.2, the separable limit at S/(S+1) = 0.923) and the corner-drained grid; one channel per SiPM without and with 3-sigma zero suppression. Triggers: sum 50 / 100 keV, per-channel OR 50 / 100 keV-equivalent, AND 50 keV-equivalent. Lines 122 / 662 / 1332 keV; rates on 662 keV.
